decision: PROPOSED kernel set for the independent SPICE check (SDR-001 D-04); not scientifically approved
use_terms: NAIF generic kernels are public; cite NAIF. Confirm exact wording before publication.
note: Horizons headers for the recorded responses state DE441 as the source ephemeris. This set uses DE440 (de440s); DE441 files are several GB. The DE440/DE441 difference for 2027 is measured as part of the residual budget, not assumed away.
